name: roleplay_agent
description: Creates a roleplay agent that can simulate conversations in a specific style and relationship context. The output will be a generated agent instance that can respond to user inputs.

name.description: The character's name. This is a required parameter.

ip.description: The intellectual property, story, or universe the character belongs to.

user_input.description: The input or prompt from the user that the agent will respond to.

relationship.description: The relationship between the agent and the user (e.g., 'close friend', 'stranger').

style.description: The communication style of the agent (e.g., 'gentle', 'formal').

user_name.description: The user's name as the agent should address them.
